item.title: How to Analyse ERC Grant Data Using Claude AI and Google Sheets
item.description: The European Commission publishes detailed data on every ERC-funded project. This data includes host institution, PI, country, funding amount, project dates, abstract, and CORDIS link. All of it is public and downloadable. Almost no one uses it, including researchers, grant advisors, and research development offices. This guide shows how to find the data, export it from the official EC database, and build interactive dashboards with Claude AI and a Google Sheets MCP connection. The whole process takes about 15 minutes.
